description: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层

latest_release.name: v2.3.0
latest_release.body:
## English

**Portuguese, Android save backup and import, foldable fullscreen on Android, a 3D resolution setting, and a lighter touch overlay on iOS.** On iOS, make a new package with the new shell. On Android, install the new APK over the old one and **make a new import pack from the 2.3.0 source** (the 2.2.x pack is refused). Your saves are untouched.

| Asset | For |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-android.apk` | **New in 2.3.0.** Android 12 and later (ARM64, Vulkan 1.1). Contains no game content. Needs an import pack made from the 2.3.0 source |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | **New in 2.3.0.** Shell for iOS 26 and later ([NO_XCODE.md](docs/NO_XCODE.md)). Build input, not installable |
| `D2RMobile-shell-ios18-build-input.zip` | **New in 2.3.0.** Shell for iOS 18 – 25 ([OLDER_SYSTEMS.md](docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.md)). Build input, not installable |
| `D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap` | Same file as v2.0.0 |

### New

- **Brazilian Portuguese** as the sixth language: all of our own text, map name plates, touch wording, and the Portuguese voice-over when your game files have it. Options → Custom now has six language choices (#224, thanks @charleslana).
- **Android: back up and import saves** without root. Put an empty `export` file in `Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/` and start the App to copy your saves to `save-export/<date-time>/`; put saves in a `save-import` folder there to add them. Import only adds characters and never replaces one already on the phone; an imported shared stash is merged. See [ANDROID.md](docs/ANDROID.md) (#213, @yyan160).
- **"3D resolution" in Options → Custom**: power saver 60 %, balanced (the platform default), sharp 100 %. Takes effect when you tap Apply (#214, @yyan160).
- **Android: true fullscreen on screens narrower than 16:9** (foldable inner panels, 4:3 tablets): the 3D fills the screen and the UI sits at 16:9 along the bottom, as on iPad (#221, thanks @vickwv).

### Improvements and fixes

- **iOS: the touch overlay no longer redraws the whole screen on every finger move**, and the skill buttons check their slots less often: less CPU while you play (#226, thanks @dormonbear).
- **Android: no crash on GPUs that lack linear filtering for some formats** (seen on a MediaTek / Mali OPPO Pad); those textures fall back to nearest sampling (#218, thanks @rex-chang).
- **Android: the Custom page no longer shows the iCloud row**, which did nothing there (#212, @yyan160).

## 中文

**新增葡萄牙语、安卓存档备份与导入、安卓折叠屏全屏、3D 清晰度设置；iOS 触屏层更省。** iOS：用新壳重新出一次安装包。安卓：覆盖安装新 APK，并**用 2.3.0 源码重做导入包**（2.2.x 的导入包会被拒）。存档都不用动。

| 附件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-android.apk` | **2.3.0 新包**。Android 12 及以上（ARM64、Vulkan 1.1）。不含游戏内容。要配 2.3.0 源码做的导入包 |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | **2.3.0 新壳**。iOS 26 及以上（[NO_XCODE.zh-CN.md](docs/NO_XCODE.zh-CN.md)）。是构建输入，不能直接装 |
| `D2RMobile-shell-ios18-build-input.zip` | **2.3.0 新壳**。iOS 18 – 25（[OLDER_SYSTEMS.zh-CN.md](docs/OLDER_SYSTEMS.zh-CN.md)）。是构建输入，不能直接装 |
| `D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap` | 与 v2.0.0 相同 |

### 新增

- **巴西葡萄牙语**，第六种语言：我们自己加的文字、地图名牌、触屏提示都有葡语，游戏文件里有葡语配音时用葡语配音。选项 → 自定义里语言变成六项（#224，感谢 @charleslana）。
- **安卓：存档备份与导入**，不用 root。在 `Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/` 放一个名为 `export` 的空文件再打开 App，存档就拷到 `save-export/<日期-时间>/`；把存档放进那里的 `save-import` 文件夹再打开 App 就导入。导入只加角色、不换掉手机上已有的；导入的共享仓库会并进来。详见 [ANDROID.zh-CN.md](docs/ANDROID.zh-CN.md)（#213，@yyan160）。
- **选项 → 自定义新增「3D 清晰度」**：省电 60% / 均衡（各平台原缺省）/ 清晰 100%，点「应用」即生效（#214，@yyan160）。
- **安卓：比 16:9 窄的屏幕真全屏**（折叠屏内屏、4:3 平板）：3D 铺满整屏，界面按 16:9 贴底，与 iPad 相同（#221，感谢 @vickwv）。

### 改进与修复

- **iOS：触屏层不再在手指每次移动时重画整屏**，技能按钮也不再每次都查一遍格子：玩的时候 CPU 占用更低（#226，感谢 @dormonbear）。
- **安卓：部分显卡对某些格式不支持线性过滤时不再闪退**（联发科 / Mali 的 OPPO Pad 上出现过），这些贴图改用最近点采样（#218，感谢 @rex-chang）。
- **安卓：自定义页不再显示 iCloud 那一行**（安卓上它不起作用）（#212，@yyan160）。

detail.readme_excerpt:
# D2R Mobile **An open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion, for iOS, macOS, Android and HarmonyOS.** It brings the Nintendo Switch release you bought, expansion included, to iPhone, iPad and Mac in full: the original game code runs natively, every control is rebuilt for touch, the frame rate holds at 60 fps, and you are in a game one second after the main menu. There is now a native macOS version as well (first version): on an Apple silicon Mac it starts on double-click and works with keyboard, mouse and gamepad. **Since v2.0 there is an Android version** (community port): the same game program executes natively on ARM64 Android phones, with the graphics reimplemented on Vulkan; on a Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 phone the camp and the Den of Evil and Cow Level fights all run at a median 60 fps (see "Android" below); a HarmonyOS version runs on the same engine (community port: an unsigned shell from the Releases page that you re-sign yourself, nothing to build; see "HarmonyOS"). Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15) has a community port (developer preview) that has reached the character-selection screen only on its author's device; see the device table below. This is not a tech demo that "sort of runs". It is a mobile version polished for daily play, from your first character all the way through the endgame. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; iOS 18 – 25 with the older-API build) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later; macOS 15 – 25 with the older-API build) · Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15; community port, developer preview) · Android phones (ARM64, Android 12 or later, Vulkan 1.1; community port) · HarmonyOS phones (HarmonyOS NEXT; community port, unsigned shell from the Releases page that you re-sign yourself) · Game version: Switch release with Reign of the Warlock, 1.0.34.0 (corresponds to PC version 3.3.94012) · English / 中文 / Español / Русский / 한국어 · License: MIT · **Bring your own game files** 中文: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) · Español: [README.es.md](README.es.md)
